name: Data Preview Cages Track

business_logic: 1. List mode (tanpa id param): load SEMUA local cages_track_record milik current user (status apapun), set dateFilter default ke tanggal hari ini (format YYYY-MM-DD lokal, terhadap field date), opsional difilter lebih lanjut oleh kata kunci pencarian (cages_track_number)
2. Render list: setiap item tampilkan label (cages_track_number atau fallback) + indikator status ('Pause' untuk draft_ongoing/draft_paused, 'Tersimpan' untuk saved, 'Tersinkron' untuk synced)
3. Render breadcrumb (Home > Production Process Activity > Cages Track > Load Data, tappable) dan header dengan hamburger
4. On tap item list berstatus draft_ongoing/draft_paused → navigasi ke Form Cages Track dengan id item tersebut
5. On tap item list berstatus saved/synced → pindah ke mode DETAIL (route dapat id param) menampilkan record tersebut read-only beserta grid Cages Tipped Time
6. On filter tanggal diubah (termasuk dikosongkan) → saring list sesuai nilai filter yang baru
7. On kata kunci pencarian dimasukkan → saring list berdasarkan kecocokan substring case-insensitive (cages_track_number)

8. Mode DETAIL: load cages_track_record by id (route param) beserta seluruh cages_tipped_time turunannya → jika ditemukan, render semua field header (termasuk Checked By/Acknowledged By apa adanya, tanpa pembatasan role untuk melihat) + grid detail read-only; jika tidak ditemukan, tampilkan error 'record tidak ditemukan' dengan Back
9. On Back di mode LIST → navigasi ke Monitor Cages Track
10. On Back di mode DETAIL → navigasi kembali ke mode LIST (id param dihapus dari route)
11. On tap breadcrumb segment → navigasi ke route terkait
12. On tap hamburger → buka menu navigasi (Ganti Password, Logout)

data_operations.description: SELECT semua local record milik current user, status apapun, opsional difilter tanggal/search (mode list)
SELECT record by id untuk detail read-only (mode detail)
SELECT semua baris by cages_track_record_id untuk mode detail

edge_case_handling.condition: Record tidak ditemukan di mode detail (id tidak valid)
edge_case_handling.handling: Tampilkan pesan error 'record tidak ditemukan' dengan tombol Back (kembali ke list, bukan Monitor)

edge_case_handling.condition: List kosong (belum ada record sama sekali)
Filter tanggal/search tidak menghasilkan apapun (termasuk saat filter default hari ini tidak ada datanya)
edge_case_handling.handling: Tampilkan pesan tidak ditemukan dengan opsi reset filter

business_rules_applied: List menampilkan seluruh record apapun statusnya
Filter tanggal & pencarian bekerja terhadap list yang sedang ditampilkan
Filter tanggal default ke hari ini saat list pertama kali dibuka
Checked By/Acknowledged By ditampilkan apa adanya di detail, tanpa pembatasan role untuk melihat

unit_test_cases.description: returns empty array when user has no local cages_track_record rows
unit_test_cases.expect: loadRecords resolves to [] (triggers list empty state upstream)

unit_test_cases.description: initializes dateFilter to today's date (YYYY-MM-DD, local) when list mode mounts
unit_test_cases.expect: dateFilter.value equals today's local date string

unit_test_cases.description: filters records by dateFilter's default (today) value on initial render
unit_test_cases.given: getAllRecords returns records dated today and yesterday; dateFilter defaults to today
unit_test_cases.expect: filteredRecords initially contains only today's record

unit_test_cases.description: allows user to change or clear the date filter after the default is applied
unit_test_cases.given: dateFilter initialized to today, user changes it to another date or clears it
unit_test_cases.expect: filteredRecords recomputes based on the new filter value, not locked to today

unit_test_cases.description: filters records by exact date match when date filter applied
unit_test_cases.given: getAllRecords returns records dated 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-15; filters = { date: '2026-08-15' }
unit_test_cases.expect: loadRecords returns only the record dated 2026-08-15

unit_test_cases.description: filters records by case-insensitive substring on cages_track_number when search keyword applied
unit_test_cases.given: getAllRecords returns records with cages_track_number 'CT-001' and 'CT-002'; filters = { search: 'ct-002' }
unit_test_cases.expect: loadRecords returns only the record with cages_track_number 'CT-002'

unit_test_cases.description: returns empty array when combined date and search filter match no record
unit_test_cases.given: getAllRecords returns records none of which match; filters = { date: '2026-08-15', search: 'xyz' }

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to Form Cages Track when tapped item status is draft_ongoing or draft_paused
unit_test_cases.expect: router navigation called toward Form Cages Track route with item.id, mode does NOT switch to detail

unit_test_cases.description: switches to detail mode when tapped item status is saved or synced
unit_test_cases.expect: router navigation called toward preview route with id param (detail mode), Form Cages Track NOT opened

unit_test_cases.description: renders record read-only with its cages_tipped_time rows when record found by id in detail mode
unit_test_cases.given: cagesTrackRepo.getDraftWithTippedTimes(id) returns a valid record with 2 cages_tipped_time rows
unit_test_cases.expect: detail state populated with all header fields + 2 tipped-time rows, readOnly flag true, no error shown

unit_test_cases.description: shows 'record tidak ditemukan' error when record not found by id in detail mode
unit_test_cases.expect: error state set to 'record tidak ditemukan' message, detail record remains null, Back action available

unit_test_cases.description: renders Checked By and Acknowledged By values in detail mode regardless of the current user's role
unit_test_cases.given: detail mode rendered for an operator user, record has checked_by and acknowledged_by both set
unit_test_cases.expect: both values shown as plain read-only text, no role-based hiding

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to Monitor Cages Track when Back pressed in list mode
unit_test_cases.expect: router navigation called toward Monitor Cages Track route

unit_test_cases.description: navigates to list mode (id param removed) when Back pressed in detail mode
unit_test_cases.expect: router navigation called toward preview route WITHOUT id param; Monitor Cages Track route is NOT targeted

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: cagesTrackRepo.getAllRecords(userId) returns valid records for the current user, no filter/lookup errors occur
unit_test_cases.expect: list mode renders the full/filtered record list successfully with correct status labels and default today filter, no exception thrown

screen_dependencies.reason: Asal navigasi (Load Data) & tujuan Back dari mode list
Tap item draft/pause membuka Form Cages Track

implementation_notes: Layar ini murni membaca data lokal SQLite, tidak ada panggilan API
Mode list dan detail berbagi 1 komponen/route yang sama (bedanya cuma ada/tidaknya :id param), mirror pola screen-013/014
Filter tanggal & search dilakukan client-side terhadap hasil query getAllRecords
Default dateFilter = tanggal lokal hari ini (format YYYY-MM-DD via todayLocalDateString()-style, BUKAN toISOString() yang UTC-based), diisi SEKALI saat komponen mount di mode list

cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts butuh fungsi baru getAllRecords(userId) (mirror weighbridgeRecordRepo.ts/gradingRecordRepo.ts's getAllRecords()) dan reuse getDraftWithTippedTimes() yang sudah ditulis ulang di screen-012 untuk mode detail

Grid Cages Tipped Time read-only: setiap baris tampilkan Time (format jam), daftar cage yang dicentang (parse checked_cage_numbers), Total Cages, Cages Remain — render langsung dari kolom tersimpan, tidak perlu hitung ulang (data historis)
